evidence.quote: The majority of our products are sold in Europe, but we are also present in the markets of North- and South America, Africa, Near and Far East. || The Kazincbarcika site in Hungary is the centre of the Company and our production activity. || we are present in the construction, automotive, furniture and clothing industries among others.
